batch.acceptance: 逐项执行本批findings的static验收；保留正常/失败/取消/部分提交与既有正确合同。独立候选复审后，由R5-I按依赖顺序整合，再由非作者复审实际commit/tree及限定字节；登记者只能登记已满足条件的限定贡献。候选PASS不等同正式接受。
batch.parallel_preparation: 可并行只读准备及在独立候选目录撰写本批片段；依赖完成前不得整合、接受或关闭对应问题。

anchors.current_statement: Spec fixes lookup value precedence, fallback and interpolation/exception boundaries, but not map consumer mutation of selected shared text.
Resolved name equality suppresses location prompt; no repeated-name or mutable raw/localized-name rule.
Continue panel shows map name and substitutes player name; does not fix that preview can alter subsequent reads before Continue/New Game.
Displays/resolves map names and filters equal names; delegates to map naming service without its mutation/lifetime rule.
Editor save order and retained shared nested changes are explicit, but pre-editor name query mutation is a different producer. It is not covered by edit/cancel semantics.
PN replacement in generic message processing says what is displayed, not map-name storage mutation; source clones this separate input.
